articles.title: Voyager 1 Is Almost One Light-Day Away
articles.summary: Voyager 1, launched in 1977, is nearly one light-day from Earth, and a power-saving upgrade should keep its science tools alive longer.

articles.title: Old Museum Frogs Solve a Vanishing Mystery
articles.summary: Tests on museum frogs show a deadly fungus arrived in Brazil's Atlantic Forest just as frogs began vanishing in the 1970s.

articles.title: Ice Age People Traveled and Mixed More Than We Thought
articles.summary: Ancient DNA shows Ice Age Europeans mixed across huge distances far earlier than scientists thought, while some groups sheltered in Spain.
